plan.title: Vendor award and PO email notification

steps.note: Create a buyer-side test event.
Provide the required event title.
Use an RFQ stage so the event can receive vendor bids and be awarded.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a line item for bidding and award.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule.
Invite two QA vendors so the winner and non-winner can be distinguished.
Publish the event for vendor bidding.
Confirm the event was published before bidding.
Have the first invited QA vendor submit a bid.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have a different invited QA vendor submit a competing bid.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Close bidding so the event can be awarded.
Award the event to the lowest bidder, the intended winning vendor.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete approval and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Confirm the created purchase order contains the awarded line item.
